scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter api start:dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web run typecheck && pnpm --filter api run typecheck
scripts.format: pnpm --filter web run format && pnpm --filter api run format && prettier --write "AGENTS.md" "docs/tech/agent-dev-flow.md" ".github/**/*.md" ".github/**/*.yml" "package.json"
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter web run format:check && pnpm --filter api run format:check && prettier --check "AGENTS.md" "docs/tech/agent-dev-flow.md" ".github/**/*.md" ".github/**/*.yml" "package.json"
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
